# Punch List

> Learn the five levels of data center commissioning, from factory witness tests to integrated systems testing, with training on commissioning, design and UPS and generator testing.

Punch List (https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Commissioning & Startup, Design Fundamentals, UPS Operations & Load Testing, Generator Operations & Maintenance training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Infrastructure Commissioning & Startup](https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/infrastructure-commissioning-startup): $267.99 per seat, 8 Hours, Commissioning Test Protocols. Lead new facility launches and major upgrades with a proven commissioning framework. Enroll: https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/infrastructure-commissioning-startup?buy=845
- [Data Center Design Fundamentals](https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-design-fundamentals): $312.99 per seat, 8 Hours, ANSI/TIA-942. Design data center facilities that scale — from site selection to redundancy strategy. Enroll: https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-design-fundamentals?buy=842
- [UPS Operations & Load Testing](https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/ups-operations-load-testing): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Master UPS operations, battery testing, and load-bank procedures. Enroll: https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/ups-operations-load-testing?buy=840
- [Generator Operations & Maintenance](https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/generator-operations-maintenance): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Size, test, and maintain backup generators with confidence. Enroll: https://dc-commissioning.hazwoperosha.us/courses/generator-operations-maintenance?buy=835
